Class JsonProxy

java.lang.Object
iu.client.JsonProxy
All Implemented Interfaces:
InvocationHandler
public final class JsonProxy extends Object implements InvocationHandler
Thin invocation handler for wrapping JSON objects in a Java interface.

Backed by IuJsonProperties, which converts each property only when its getter is first called, and keeps the result. The JSON object a proxy unwraps to is the one it wraps, or, for a proxy of Java values, one generated once when first needed.
